items.caption: This received seal-script form of 給 is recorded with 糸 as the semantic component and 合 as the phonetic component.
items.alt: Black seal-style 給 glyph on a white background, with a left component of two enclosed shapes and a larger angular component on the right.
items.selection_reason: The visible form is legible and relevant to the received Shuowen component analysis. It is a modern redraw of a seal-script form, not an ancient artifact image.

limitations.text: No verified early inscription or dated manuscript forms are available here, so the earliest graphic form and its development remain uncertain. This image shows a modern redraw of the received Shuowen seal-script form.
